hook.say: How well do you know Turkey? Five questions, three seconds each. Number four trips up even locals!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: What is the capital of Türkiye?
questions.say: What is the capital of Turkey?
questions.sayAnswer: Ankara! It became the capital in 1923.
Mount Ararat! It rises to 5137 meters.

questions.fact: Lake Van is so big that locals call it a sea.
questions.sayAnswer: Lake Van! It is so big that locals call it a sea.

questions.q: How many provinces does Türkiye have?
questions.say: How many provinces does Turkey have?
questions.fact: 81 provinces, from Edirne in the west to Hakkâri in the east.
questions.sayAnswer: Eighty-one! From Edirne in the west, to Hakkari in the east.

questions.q: Which is Türkiye's largest province by area?
questions.say: Which is Turkey's largest province by area?
questions.sayAnswer: Konya! It is bigger than Belgium.
